findings.claim: assertSliceWithFake accepts any subclass of BookingService declared inside the test, including an empty anonymous subclass that overrides nothing. Critic run on a private solution with the fake's byId override removed (the bean method returns an anonymous BookingService subclass with an empty body): all 11 tests pass, because the real BookingService has a public no-arg constructor that seeds one booking and its own byId already throws NoSuchElementException for any other id. So web-layer-tests-with-mockmvc#o2 ("a fake that finds nothing") can be met with the real service logic. Low: the README and hint say to override byId, and the edit is unlikely.
findings.recommendation: Also assert that the fake overrides byId (for example, the bean class declares byId itself via getDeclaredMethod), or have the 404 test request the seeded id 1 so only a fake that finds nothing passes.
